headline: v3.14 foundation — first-run questionnaire infrastructure + new event types

items.prompt_template: Quiet foundation update preparing for new skills coming in upcoming releases. Adds the infrastructure for skills to remember your first-time setup answers between sessions, so when a new skill asks you 3-5 setup questions, it only asks once — not every time you fire it. Nothing for you to do; the next wave of skills will use this automatically.
